title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened Burkina Faso's social protection system by revitalizing national coordination, expanding the Unified Social Registry, and advancing the operationalization of the redesigned PAMPV. Support focused on economic inclusion, improved data systems, frontline capacity building, and evidence-based advocacy to enhance resilience and service delivery for vulnerable households.
